workerResult.summary: Juniper Signal Garden — glassmorphism signal-farming game: 3 seed types (Ember/Frost/Verdant) with distinct tones and grow times, 4x4 garden grid with seed→sprout→flashing-mature stages plus tap-to-boost, 6-rune harvest code with copy, win banner, score/time/best (localStorage). WebAudio bleeps on every interaction, first harvest in ~5s, full round in ~30s. Responsive at 375px.
